description: BIND named.conf audit — Offline security audit of an ISC BIND 9 named.conf (options, acl, view, zone, key, controls, statistics-channels, logging). Detects open recursive resolvers using real BIND fallback rules (allow-recursion falls back to allow-query-cache, then allow-query - so allow-query { any; } with recursion on is an open resolver), ACLs that expand to any, zone transfers open to anyone or authorized by IP only, allow-transfer left unset on primary zones, dynamic updates from anyone or by IP without TSIG, rndc controls and statistics channels exposed off-loopback, version.bind / hostname.bind disclosure, DNSSEC validation disabled, mixed authoritative+recursive service, missing response rate limiting and logging, HMAC-MD5 TSIG keys, inline secrets (never echoed) and removed/deprecated options. Views are checked with options inheritance. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, findings with fixes, a summary and a hardened example. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
